diagnostics.message:
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The GitHub App update can register the endpoint before the API Gateway route exists; the endpoint value depends on the API URL and path, not on route creation. Make the update wait for the route to be usable.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The GitHub App is configured with the webhook endpoint by this resource, but its references do not establish that the API route exists before that external registration runs. The route is needed for the endpoint to accept webhook requests.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The GitHub App update can register the endpoint before its API Gateway stage is deployed. Make the update wait for the stage so the newly registered URL is serving traffic.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The webhook endpoint is registered with GitHub by `module.webhook-github-app:resource.null_resource.update_app`, but its current references only establish dependencies on the API object and other webhook outputs, not on the deployed `$default` stage. Ensure the stage is ready before registering the endpoint so GitHub is not configured to send events to an endpoint that is not yet live.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
An EventBridge schedule can invoke the scale-down Lambda as soon as the target is installed, but the target does not wait for its Lambda invoke permission. Order target creation after the permission.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The EventBridge target can invoke the scale-down Lambda, but it does not wait for the Lambda permission granting EventBridge invocation. Add ordering so the target is not active before the permission is installed.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The scheduled scale-down target can become active before its Lambda invoke permission exists, so an invocation during deployment may fail. Make the target wait for the permission.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The scheduled syncer target may become active before EventBridge has permission to invoke the Lambda. Make the target wait for the corresponding Lambda permission.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The EventBridge target can begin invoking the syncer Lambda as soon as it is active, but it has no dependency on the Lambda resource-based permission that authorizes EventBridge invocation. Order target creation after the permission to avoid a delivery window where invocations are rejected.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The EventBridge target can be installed before its Lambda invoke permission, allowing a scheduled invocation to fail during deployment. Make the target wait for the permission.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
A pool schedule can invoke the pool Lambda as soon as its target is installed, but the target does not wait for the Lambda invoke permission. Order target creation after the permission.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The scheduled pool target can invoke its Lambda, but it has no dependency on the corresponding Lambda permission for EventBridge. Ensure the permission is in place before activating the target.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The pool EventBridge target can be created before the Lambda invoke permission, permitting a scheduled invocation to fail during deployment. Make the target wait for the permission.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
The SQS event source mapping can begin polling and invoking the scale-up Lambda once enabled, but it does not wait for the Lambda execution role policy that grants access to the queue and other required resources. Ensure the policy is attached before activating the mapping.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
An SQS event source mapping can start polling and invoke the scale-up Lambda immediately. The mapping does not wait for the inline execution-role policy that grants the Lambda permission to consume the build queue, risking failed polling or invocations while the policy is absent or propagating.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The SQS event source mapping can become active before the scale-up execution role has its SQS permissions, which can cause polling or invocations to fail during deployment. Make the mapping wait for the role policy.
